items.meta_description: [store] is an authorized reseller of VpnHood! Premium. See what buying from [store] gives you, and how to check any seller.
items.sample_note: This is a sample of the page each authorized reseller gets on vpnhood.com, made for a store that doesn't exist. Become a reseller
items.page_desc: [store] has sold genuine VpnHood! Premium as an authorized reseller since [since].
items.hero_alt: The hooded VpnHood guardian hands a hooded reseller a ring of glowing keys with the VpnHood seal
items.point_works_desc: Premium from [store] works in VpnHood! CONNECT on Android, iPhone and iPad, Mac, Windows and Linux, on up to five devices at once.
items.point_help_desc: [store] is your first contact for questions about your code and your plan, and reaches our team when needed.
items.point_app_desc: You connect with VpnHood! CONNECT, the same app our own customers use.
items.app_shot_alt: The home screen of VpnHood! CONNECT on a phone
items.apple_desc: Apple doesn't let an app accept a premium code, so on Apple devices the code reaches the app through the buyer's VpnHood! account.
items.apple_link: How to use a premium code on Apple devices
items.terms_art_alt: A shop's paid receipt with a glowing key
items.terms_payment: Payments and refunds. [store] takes your payment, so take a refund or any payment question to [store]. VpnHood! can't refund or change a purchase made with [store].
items.terms_renewal: Renewals. Your plan's length and its renewal are with [store] too.
items.terms_reversal: Reversed payments. If a payment is refunded or charged back, [store] may end the premium code it paid for.
items.terms_details: Your details. The details of your purchase stay with [store] and are not sent to us.
items.check_title: How to know a seller is authorized
items.check_desc: Every authorized reseller has a page like this one on our website, at an address made from its own: www.vpnhood.com/authorized-reseller/[domain]/ for [store]. If a seller has no such page, it is not authorized.
